searchText: <@!340345049063882753> We recently opened this chat for discv5 questions, sharing progress in interop, and implementation issues. If you're working on discv5 interop, let us know what you need, and we'll try to help. awesome, thanks for the invite. So to give an update, the discv5 implementation from Harmony has been poked and prodded a bit to become https://github.com/PegaSysEng/discovery and there's a PR open to integrate that into Teku. I've also spent some time today investigating the discv5 implementation from Tuweni and have done a quick and dirty integration of it into Teku. Both are able to do a handshake with Lighthouse running locally properly. I seem to have done something bad to my local Lighthouse nodes and they aren't connecting to each other anymore, so not sure if discovery is actually working with the integration. I'm having some trouble getting rumor installed. On both MacOS and the `golang` docker image `go get -u github.com/protolambda/rumor` fails with: ```rc/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/gossipsub.go:437:11: log.EventBegin undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method EventBegin) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:407:8: log.Warning undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method Warning) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:412:8: log.Warning undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method Warning) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:426:8: log.Warning undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method Warning) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:432:8: log.Warning undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method Warning) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:454:8: log.Warning undefined (type *log.ZapEventLogger has no field or method Warning) src/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/pubsub.go:454:8: too many errors``` I'm using logrus, not zap. That's weird Yeah, it looks like go-libp2p-pubsub is failing to install and it hasn't even gotten to rumor yet. It should just work, no zap required by rumor, and I doubt pubsub uses it. Try `go get -u ./...` (three dots for full package traversal) After git cloning it On mobile now, will try on laptop in a minute `go get -u ./...` gave: ```# github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-kad-dht ../pkg/mod/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-kad-dht@v0.5.0/dht.go:157:5: assignment mismatch: 1 variable but kbucket.NewRoutingTable returns 2 values ../pkg/mod/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-kad-dht@v0.5.0/dht.go:341:18: dht.routingTable.Update undefined (type *kbucket.RoutingTable has no field or method Update) ../pkg/mod/github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-kad-dht@v0.5.0/notif.go:111:18: dht.routingTable.Remove undefined (type *kbucket.RoutingTable has no field or method Remove) ``` Ok, looks like ipfs logger uses zap in the back Sounds like I should probably go talk to them. Maybe try fresh without the u flag, think that forced an incompatible update Trying that now. Just grabbed the ENR for Lighthouse's testnet from the readme and gave it a try. Discovering tons of peers which is awesome to see. No luck with the go get though. I'll go ask the go-libp2p crowd and see if they know something. Oh, also: git clone and local running might be required, as the rumor go module uses a replace directive to use the go-ethereum fork of <@!194432762315407360> (where the latest dv5 work is, the geth master branch is out of date) managed to reproduce with `-u`, works without. I'll see if I can pin some indirect dependency versions to fix that. Shouldn't happen with minor go-libp2p updates though. https://github.com/golang/go/issues/34189 looks somewhat relevant. Apparently the latest version of libp2p is reported wrong. Found the issue, adding `go.sum` so you always have the correct deps I generally like omitting it, to find this kind of stuff in experimental software. `go-libp2p-kbucket` was updated, and just broke in combination with master v0.5 kad-dht. Oh well. Fixed it, install instructions in readme Yep, that's working now. Thanks. well, have fun with the REPL, it has a lot of networking commands, so you're bound to break either the REPL or a client if you experiment enough On a slightly related note, <@!194432762315407360> let me know what the status is on the different geth discovery v5 branches. I would love to just use upstream master branch to pull in dv5. <@510413979080720385> <@453997683431178243> <@553610810652622860> I've played with Lighthouse's bootstrap nodes as well, but we have plenty of code changes since then. Will be happy to do another test soon We've migrated our entire bootstrap process to ENR records, so we are now publishing ENR URIs in the testnet metadata files: https://github.com/eth2-clients/eth2-testnets/blob/master/nimbus/testnet1/bootstrap_nodes.txt Hey, sorry for not replying till now Happy you created this channel Go-ethereum discv5 branch is still fjl/discover-v5-rebase I'm working on getting it into master right now Jannik has been leading the charge but we do have a py impl of discv5 in Trinity
